note: Sources of the engine's TLS and font libraries, pinned by SHA-256. tools/fetch-inputs.sh downloads and verifies them into $WARZAG_CACHE (default ~/Library/Caches/warzag-build); runtime/n/fetch.sh runs it along with the engine's own inputs (runtime/n/inputs.lock.json).

crossover-sources.use: gmp, gnutls and freetype sources for the engine's arm64 libraries (runtime/n/build.sh deps)

nettle.use: nettle for gnutls (the CrossOver tarball ships nettle without its Makefile.in templates)
